say.zh: 外面下雨了，你带伞了吗？
say.en: It is raining outside. Did you bring an umbrella?
Yes, I have. It is in my bag.
What fruit would you like to eat?
I would like an apple.
How do you go to school?
I go by bike.
What are you reading?
I am reading a book.
Is today your birthday?

say.zh: 是啊，我妈妈给我买了蛋糕。
say.en: Yes. My mother bought me a cake.
What is wrong with you?
I have a headache. I am going to the hospital.
What do you like to do at the weekend?
I like to go swimming.

say.zh: 你想吃米饭还是面条儿？
say.en: Would you like rice or noodles?
I would like noodles.
How are you going abroad?
I am going by plane.
What do you like to listen to?
I like listening to music.
It is really cold today. It has started to snow outside.

say.zh: 是啊，我们在家看电视吧。
say.en: Yes, let us watch TV at home.
Spring has come and the flowers are all out.
Let us go to the park to see the flowers.
How is this shirt?
The size is not bad. I will buy one.
Your shoes are very dirty.

say.zh: 我刚跑步回来，回家就洗。
say.en: I have just come back from a run. I will wash them when I get home.
The moon is very big tonight.
Yes, it is really beautiful.
How do you come to the company every day?
I take the subway. It is fast.
What is wrong with your phone?
It has no battery left.
Do you have any money? Lend me a hundred yuan.
Okay, here you are.
Where do you work?

say.zh: 我在学校工作，我是老师。
say.en: I work at a school. I am a teacher.
Can you drive?
Yes, I can. I went by car yesterday.

say.zh: 我家离公司很远，我每天坐一个小时的地铁去上班。
say.en: My home is far from my company. Every day I take the subway for an hour to go to work.

st: He takes the subway to work.

say.zh: 昨天晚上我看了一个很长的电影，今天有点儿累。
say.en: Yesterday evening I watched a very long film, so today I am a little tired.

say.zh: 我和朋友说好六点在饭馆见面，可是我五点半就到了。
say.en: My friend and I agreed to meet at the restaurant at six, but I arrived at half past five.

say.zh: 今天天气很好，我们打算下午去公园玩。
say.en: The weather is very good today. We plan to go to the park this afternoon.

st: They are going to the park in the afternoon.

say.zh: 我的手机坏了，我想去商店买一个新的。
say.en: My phone is broken. I want to go to a shop to buy a new one.

st: He wants to buy a new phone.

say.zh: 小明的汉语说得很好，因为他在中国学习了两年。
say.en: Xiao Ming speaks Chinese very well, because he studied in China for two years.

st: Xiao Ming has never been to China.

say.zh: 我想吃面条儿，但是饭馆里的面条儿卖完了，所以我吃了米饭。
say.en: I wanted noodles, but the restaurant had sold out of noodles, so I ate rice.

say.zh: 明天是我妈妈的生日，我给她买了一个蛋糕。
say.en: Tomorrow is my mother's birthday. I bought her a cake.

st: He bought his mother a cake.

say.zh: 医生说我感冒了，要多喝水，多休息。
say.en: The doctor said I have a cold and should drink more water and rest more.

st: The doctor told him to rest more.

say.zh: 我每个星期六都去打篮球，今天下雨了，所以不能去了。
say.en: I play basketball every Saturday. Today it rained, so I cannot go.

st: He went to play basketball today.

say.zh: 这个房间很干净，也很安静，我很满意。
say.en: This room is very clean and also very quiet. I am very satisfied.

st: He is very satisfied with this room.

say.zh: 我的同学住在学校附近，他走路十分钟就能到学校。
say.en: My classmate lives near the school. He can get to school in ten minutes on foot.

say.zh: 我觉得中国菜很好吃，可是我不会做。
say.en: I think Chinese food is delicious, but I cannot cook it.

say.zh: 老师说明天考试，所以我今天晚上要认真复习。
say.en: The teacher said there is an exam tomorrow, so tonight I have to review carefully.

say.zh: 我哥哥比我高，也比我大三岁。
say.en: My older brother is taller than me and also three years older.

st: His older brother is younger than him.

say.zh: 我下个月去国外，机票已经买好了。
say.en: I am going abroad next month. I have already bought the plane ticket.

st: He has already bought the plane ticket.

say.zh: 孩子们在公园里一边唱歌，一边跳舞。
say.en: The children are singing and dancing in the park.

st: The children are in the park.

say.zh: 我今天忘了带伞，下雨的时候没有办法回家。
say.en: I forgot to bring an umbrella today, so when it rained I had no way to get home.

say.zh: 我弟弟喜欢踢足球，他每个周末都和同学一起踢。
say.en: My younger brother likes playing soccer. Every weekend he plays with his classmates.

say.zh: 这家商店的东西很贵，我只买了一杯咖啡。
say.en: The things in this shop are very expensive, so I only bought a cup of coffee.

st: 这家商店的东西很便宜。
The things in this shop are cheap.

say.zh: 老师让我们先读课文，然后回答问题。
say.en: The teacher asks us to read the text first and then answer the questions.

say.zh: 我爸爸四十岁了，他每天早上都去跑步，身体很好。
say.en: My father is forty now. He goes running every morning and is in good health.

st: His father is not in good health.

say.zh: 我们学校有一个很大的图书馆，我常常去那里看书。
say.en: Our school has a very big library, and I often go there to read.

st: He often goes to the library.

say.zh: 昨天我在路上遇到了老同学，我们一起喝了咖啡。
say.en: Yesterday I ran into an old classmate on the street, and we had coffee together.

st: He saw an old classmate yesterday.

say.en: Why have you still not eaten?

say.zh: 我今天工作很忙，没有时间。
say.en: I am very busy at work today and have no time.

q.en: Why has the man not eaten?

say.en: What are your plans for the weekend?
I want to go hiking with a friend.

q.en: What does the woman want to do at the weekend?

say.en: How much is this piece of clothing?
A hundred and twenty yuan. It is very cheap.

q.en: How much is this piece of clothing?

say.en: Why were you late today?
Sorry, there were too many cars on the road.

q.en: Why was the woman late?

say.en: Can you swim?
Yes, I can. I learned when I was a child.

q.zh: 男的是什么时候学会游泳的？
q.en: When did the man learn to swim?

say.en: Have you seen my phone?
It is on the table, next to the book.

q.en: Where is the phone?

say.en: What time is tomorrow's meeting?
Two in the afternoon, on the third floor.

q.en: Where do they hold the meeting?

say.en: Do you like this city?

say.zh: 喜欢，这里夏天不太热，人也很热情。
say.en: Yes. The summer here is not too hot and the people are friendly.

q.zh: 女的觉得这个城市怎么样？
q.en: What does the woman think of this city?

say.en: Would you like tea or coffee?

say.zh: 我晚上不想喝咖啡，喝茶吧。
say.en: I do not want coffee in the evening. Let us have tea.

q.en: What does the man want to drink?

say.en: Have you finished this book?
Not yet. I have only read half.

q.en: How much has the woman read?

say.en: Why are you learning Chinese?
I want to go and work in China.

q.en: Why is the man learning Chinese?

say.en: Let us go by subway.
No need. I will drive you.

q.en: How does the woman want to go?

say.en: When is your birthday?

say.zh: 十月二十八号，就是下个星期。
say.en: On 28 October, next week.

q.en: When is the man's birthday?

say.en: Why did you not bring your child?
He is at home doing his homework.

q.en: What is the child doing?

say.en: Excuse me, where is the bank?

say.zh: 一直往前走，在超市旁边。
say.en: Go straight ahead. It is next to the supermarket.

q.en: Where is the bank?

say.zh: 你今天看起来不太高兴。
say.en: You do not look very happy today.
No, I did not do well in the exam.

q.en: Why is the woman unhappy?

say.en: What time shall we leave?

say.zh: 八点吧，早一点儿，路上人少。
say.en: Eight o'clock. Let us go a bit early, when there are fewer people on the road.

q.en: What time will they leave?

say.en: You speak Chinese really well.

say.zh: 谢谢，我每天都听一个小时的中文歌。
say.en: Thank you. I listen to Chinese songs for an hour every day.

q.en: How does the woman study Chinese?

say.en: Would you like to buy the big one or the small one?
I like the small one. I do not want the big one.

q.en: Which one does the man want?

say.en: How is the food in this restaurant?
Very tasty, but a bit expensive.

q.zh: 女的觉得这家饭馆怎么样？
q.en: What does the woman think of this restaurant?

say.en: Hello, where are you now?

say.zh: 我还在路上，地铁里人太多了。
say.en: I am still on the way. There are too many people on the subway.

say.zh: 电影六点半开始，快一点儿。
say.en: The film starts at half past six. Hurry up a bit.
Okay, I will be there right away.

q.en: What time does the film start?

say.en: I want to buy a new phone.

say.zh: 你的手机不是才买了一年吗？
say.en: Did you not buy your phone only a year ago?
But it is too slow now.
Then you had better go and look in a shop first.

q.zh: 男的为什么想买新手机？
q.en: Why does the man want to buy a new phone?

say.zh: 你昨天为什么没来上课？
say.en: Why did you not come to class yesterday?
I had a cold and a fever too.
Are you a bit better now?

say.zh: 好多了，我明天可以上课。
say.en: Much better. I can come to class tomorrow.

q.en: What can the man do tomorrow?

say.en: Where do you want to go this weekend?
I want to go to the seaside.
I heard it is going to rain at the weekend.
Then let us go to see a film.

q.en: What will they probably do at the weekend?

say.zh: 你这件衬衫很好看，是在哪儿买的？
say.en: This shirt of yours looks nice. Where did you buy it?
At the shop next to the school.
Is it expensive?
Not expensive, only eighty yuan.

q.en: How much is the shirt?

say.en: How many people are in your family?

say.zh: 四口人，爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。
say.en: Four: my father, my mother, my older brother and me.
What does your older brother do?

say.zh: 他是医生，在一家大医院工作。
say.en: He is a doctor and works at a big hospital.

q.en: What does her older brother do?

say.zh: 明天的考试你准备好了吗？
say.en: Are you ready for tomorrow's exam?

say.zh: 还没有，我还有两课没复习。
say.en: Not yet. I still have two lessons to review.

say.zh: 别担心，我们一起复习吧。
say.en: Do not worry. Let us review together.
Great, thank you.

q.en: How many lessons does the man still have to review?

say.en: Please give me a glass of water.
Would you like it cold or hot?

say.zh: 热的吧，我有点儿不舒服。
say.en: Hot, please. I do not feel very well.
Okay, please wait a moment.

q.en: What does the man want?

say.en: How do you go to work every day?

say.zh: 我以前坐地铁，现在骑自行车。
say.en: I used to take the subway. Now I ride a bike.
Why?

say.zh: 我骑车可以锻炼身体，也不用等车。
say.en: When I cycle I can get exercise, and I do not have to wait for a bus.

q.en: How does the man go to work now?

say.en: What is the date today?
October 31.
Oh, tomorrow is already November!
Yes, time goes by so fast.

q.en: What month is it tomorrow?

say.zh: 我想学开车，你觉得难吗？
say.en: I want to learn to drive. Do you think it is hard?

say.zh: 不难，我学了一个月就会了。
say.en: It is not hard. I could already drive after a month.
One month? So fast!
If you practise a lot, it will be the same for you.

q.en: How long did the man take to learn?

say.en: Do you like spring or autumn?

say.zh: 我喜欢秋天，不冷也不热。
say.en: I like autumn. It is not cold or hot.
I like spring. The flowers have all come out.

say.zh: 春天也很好，就是常常下雨。
say.en: Spring is nice too, but it often rains.

q.en: Which season does the woman like?

say.en: What book are you reading?
A book about history.
Is it good?

say.zh: 很有意思，我已经看了三天了。
say.en: It is very interesting. I have been reading it for three days already.

q.en: How long has the man been reading?

say.en: Where did you learn to cook?
I learned from my mother.

say.zh: 你妈妈做的菜一定很好吃。
say.en: The food your mother cooks must be delicious.
Yes. Next time you come and eat at my home.

q.en: Who did the woman learn to cook from?
